Meet the team

Why ShipIn

Built by seafarers for seafarers

ShipIn was founded by people who understand what it’s like to operate vessels at sea. We build technology that supports crews and operators in real conditions, not systems designed only in a lab.

Committed to the people and industry we serve

ShipIn operates as a Public Benefit Corporation. That means we are committed to improving safety and transparency across maritime operations while building a company that serves shipowners, crews, and the broader industry.

Driven by innovation at sea

ShipIn is building a new category of maritime technology. By combining AI, computer vision, and deep operational insight, we are tackling challenges that have never been solved before. The complexity of what we build makes the work here deeply engaging, requiring creativity, curiosity, and the courage to think beyond conventional solutions.

Open Positions

Don’t See the Right Role for You?
Send Us Your Resume.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We’re always looking for talent. If you do not see the right maritime industry job opening for you, but are still interested in joining us to transform Maritime Shipping, please send your resume to careers@shipin.ai.

Why Now

The maritime industry is entering a new phase where operational visibility and safety intelligence are becoming essential. ShipIn is helping define this category, with deployments on thousands of vessels and billions of hours of real-world operational data.

We are still early in building the platform fleets will rely on to understand and manage operational risk at sea, so there is much to build from the ground up.

Our Values

Crew-first

A strong ship depends on its crew. We treat each other with respect, support one another, and create an environment where people can thrive.

Always growing

We get better by doing. Challenges are not obstacles - they’re how we learn. We step outside our comfort zone, try new things, and improve with every step.

Own the ship

We take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. When something isn’t working, we don’t wait - we step in, fix it, and make sure things move forward.

One crew

We succeed together. We share knowledge, communicate openly, and support each other to move faster and make better decisions.

Trust is the product

Accuracy, transparency, and reliability are non-negotiable. If we lose trust, we lose everything.

Benefits and support

Building technology that improves safety at sea is serious work. We want ShipIn to be a place where people can do meaningful work while being supported in their careers and lives.

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity
  • Health, dental, and vision coverage
  • Flexible PTO and paid holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Learning and development support
  • Hybrid-friendly ways of working
  • Opportunity to become a ship captain through The Captain Program
